name: Heroic Saga
detailed_description:
Heroic Saga It is a martial arts open-world RPG game based on the historical background of the last years of the Northern and Southern Dynasties of China.

When did the hundreds of years of turmoil and strife end, in a remote village deep in the Qinling Mountains, four words were written on the cliff wall behind the village, "The world is peaceful······

Game Features:

Explore: 20 square kilometers of seamless open-world ancient style map, with four distinct seasons, including: villages, ancient roads, towns, forests and other scenes

Collection: Dozens of antiques, calligraphy and paintings can be collected

Martial arts: The free combination of basic exercises and weapon systems, swords, guns and sticks are up to you

Combat: 3D perspective real-time combat system

Skills: If you want to be in the rivers and lakes, you also need to master certain survival skills, and survival skills can be learned from a variety of paths

short_description: Heroic Saga It is a martial arts open-world RPG game based on the historical background of the last years of the Northern and Southern Dynasties of China. You will play as a teenager born in a remote mountain village to explore this unknown world.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 兼容 Windows 的音频设备
